info.title: DomuSafe API
info.description: REST API of DomuSafe Suite. Errors follow RFC 9457 (application/problem+json) with a stable `code`. Writes of versioned resources require If-Match; creations require Idempotency-Key; cookie-authenticated writes require the header X-DomuSafe-Request: 1. Authentication endpoints are served by Better Auth under /api/auth.
